author: Susan Jenkins
text: I have the new app. I use a cover on my sensor because I 2 fell off before I got my cover on. I have an iPhone 12 Pro and I updated to 17. Something. I later found out that the iOS is not compatible and some alarms may not function. It works ok. The new 3 plus sensors did not stay on great not sure if it was bad adhesive the small adhesive surface or damp skin. I put the cover on as soon as I get the sensor on. Haven’t lost one since.
